name: Cludo Search
description: Client-side integration of the Cludo hosted (SaaS) site-search widget: renders a search form and result containers while Cludo's browser JavaScript queries the Cludo API and renders results.
project_description:
This module allows users to set up Cludo search https://www.cludo.com/ on their website, it sets up search blocks for the form and for the results page.

 There is a configuration page where you can add your Cludo Authentication details and the path to your search page.

 There is also other options for additional customisations. See https://cludo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003954911-How-to-use-and… .

 The project is not sponsored or supported by Cludo.

 All credit goes to https://github.com/Kirchheimer the original creator of this project.
